name: Francis Chisom Ali
role: Software Engineer — Backend & Systems, Cross-Platform Development
bio: Over 5 years of hands-on software development building for people — from backend web systems and REST APIs to cross-platform desktop apps and Android applications. A Mechatronics Engineering background isn't incidental; it shapes how software gets approached, as a system with moving parts that have to talk to each other reliably. That's led into programming ESP32 microcontrollers for IoT pipelines, building FFT-based audio processing into a live Android app, running local LLM inference with Llama.cpp, and writing C++/Python interop layers for a custom HTML renderer. On the more conventional side: Django, Flask, Celery, Redis and PostgreSQL on the backend, Kivy and Java for desktop and Android.
contactBlurb: Open to backend, systems, and cross-platform engineering work — freelance or full-time.

experience.title: Fire Safety Regulatory Document Clause Comparison (ML)
experience.description: Built a parser extracting Sections, Subsections and Clauses from UK fire safety regulation documents with 95%+ structural accuracy, generated embeddings with a Mini-LM Sentence Transformer for semantic clause comparison, and designed a relational database behind a Vue.js web interface, deployed on Hugging Face Spaces using Agile methodology.

experience.title: Bank Fraud Classification
experience.description: Analysed a financial dataset in R to classify fraudulent transactions using statistical methods, and produced visual reports and graphs communicating the results clearly to a non-technical client.

experience.title: Email Scraping
experience.description: Scraped 300+ websites with BeautifulSoup to extract email address patterns, manually distinguishing genuine addresses from look-alike text, and delivered results in CSV and Excel format using Pandas.

experience.title: amqtt — Android Compatibility Fix
experience.description: Identified that amqtt's hard dependency on Psutil — used only by a bundled plugin — was breaking installation on Android, then filed an issue and submitted a pull request; the maintainer scheduled the dependency for deprecation in a future release.

projects.title: Websurface.py
projects.description: A custom HTML rendering surface embedded in a Python/Kivy app: a C++/Python interop layer using the Ultralight rendering engine renders HTML to an off-screen buffer, mapped directly onto Kivy's canvas for live web content in a native Python GUI.

projects.title: Autosink
projects.description: A distributed file monitoring and event tracking system with remote access: detects and logs file creation, modification and deletion events via Celery workers and Redis, persists an audit trail to SQLite, propagates events over MQTT, and exposes a Flask web dashboard.

projects.title: AceFret
projects.description: A cross-platform music education app training guitarists to identify and locate fretboard notes in real time, using FFT-based pitch detection on live microphone input, TarsosDSP on Android and a NumPy/SciPy pipeline on desktop, with flashcard prompts and a time-challenge mechanic.

projects.title: Beryl
projects.description: A Django web app letting students photograph or upload a past exam question and retrieve matching solutions from the web. OCR extracts text from the image, feeding a BeautifulSoup4 scraping pipeline, with a frontend built for minimal friction on the core search workflow.

projects.title: IoT Monitoring & Control System
projects.description: A collaborative real-time sensor monitoring and remote hardware control system: ESP32 firmware reads sensor input and publishes over MQTT to a central broker, with a web dashboard for live data visualisation and remote control, including dynamic lamp brightness adjustment.

projects.title: Multi-Agent LLM Conversation System
projects.description: An autonomous two-model conversation framework for observing emergent LLM behaviour: a threaded Python system lets two local LLM instances converse open-endedly on a topic, running entirely offline via Llama.cpp on a quantised Llama-3.2-1B GGUF model from Hugging Face.

projects.title: Whisper STT Tool
projects.description: An offline speech-to-text transcription tool wrapping Whisper.cpp with a simple Python interface.

projects.title: Calibration Chart Organiser
projects.description: An OCR-based document classification tool built for a logistics and calibration firm, using Tesseract OCR and Pillow with a Kivy interface.

projects.title: Solfer
projects.description: A web app for tonic solfa notation training with real-time feedback and WAV export for paid users. In progress.

projects.title: CSV → Google Sheets Sync Tool
projects.description: A utility for instantly backing up local CSV data to Google Sheets via the Google Cloud API with OAuth authentication.

projects.title: WiFi LAN Communicator
projects.description: An offline desktop calling application for local corporate environments, using socket-based peer communication. In progress.
